items.title: First cohomology of a finite dimensional continuous module over a topologically finitely generated group is finite dimensional
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file etale-cohomology.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261011
items.difficulty_reason: The lemma bounds the first cohomology of a finite dimensional continuous module over a topologically finitely generated group: it is finite dimensional (statement lines 8940-8946). The proof is a complete argument: the companion lemma identifies the group with a space of extensions (proof lines 8949-8954); choosing topological generators and a lift of the generator of the quotient attaches to each extension finitely many vectors of the module, so that the extension space is a subquotient of a finite power of a finite dimensional vector space (proof lines 8955-8966); and continuity together with the density of the subgroup generated by the chosen elements shows that those vectors determine the extension, completing the argument (proof lines 8967-8975). The non-formal content is the encoding of an extension by finitely many vectors. The claim is H2: a structured reduction with the continuity input used explicitly.
